title: Network speed graph can't be highlighted using pointer when hidden to some extent
line: Hovering a list item in the Networks, Bluetooth or other applets now highlights it even when it's partly scrolled out of view.
explanation: ExpandableListItem moves the ListView's currentIndex (which draws the hover highlight) on hover, but skipped items that weren't fully visible, because setting currentIndex makes ListView scroll to show the whole item (bug 387797, QTBUG-114574). So an expanded network partly scrolled out of view never got the highlight. Now, for such items, the hover handler still sets currentIndex and then writes contentY back: ListView only follows the current item while its move reason is 'set index', and setting contentY resets that, so the view stays where it is. This is skipped while the view is moving so wheel scrolling isn't cut short.

commits.message:
ExpandableListItem: highlight partially visible items on hover

Hovering an item that was partly scrolled out of view didn't highlight
it, because changing currentIndex would make the view scroll to it. Now
contentY is set back afterwards, which keeps the view where it was.

BUG: 512397

media.caption: Master (sweep tester, kdetest6): Wired 1 expanded and scrolled so only the bottom of its speed graph shows; pointer over the graph, card not highlighted
With the fix: same scroll position, pointer over the graph, the card is highlighted and the list doesn't move
With the fix: hovering the cut-off card, the rows below and the cut-off Wired 5 row at the bottom; each highlights and the list never jumps
